performance.title: Performance
performance.description: Evaluates page load speed, responsiveness, and Core Web Vitals.

audits.title: Server response time (TTFB)
audits.description: Time to First Byte indicates how fast your web server responds.

audits.title: Avoid an excessive DOM size
audits.description: A small DOM size reduces memory consumption and accelerates reflows.

audits.title: Eliminate render-blocking resources
audits.description: Scripts are loaded with asynchronous strategies to prevent blocking DOM render.

audits.title: Serve images in next-gen formats
audits.description: Image formats like WebP and AVIF provide superior compression over PNG/JPEG.

audits.title: Ensure text remains visible during webfont load
audits.description: Using font-display: swap enables visitors to read text immediately while fonts load.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.description: Checks whether all users can navigate, understand, and interact with the page.

audits.title: <html> element has a [lang] attribute
audits.description: Screen readers rely on language tags to pronounce words accurately.

audits.title: Image elements have [alt] attributes
audits.description: Informative alt text enables blind and visually impaired users to understand images.

audits.title: Heading elements appear in a sequentially descending order
audits.description: Semantically structured headings provide vital navigation landmarks for screen readers.

audits.title: Page contains landmark regions (main, header, footer)
audits.description: Landmark elements partition pages into meaningful navigational sections.

audits.title: Buttons have an accessible name
audits.description: When a button doesn't have an accessible name, screen readers announce it as 'button'.

bestPractices.title: Best Practices
bestPractices.description: Ensures modern web development standards, security, and error prevention.

audits.title: Page has the HTML5 doctype
audits.description: Specifying a doctype prevents the browser from switching to quirks-mode.

audits.title: Properly defines character set
audits.description: A character encoding declaration is required to display text correctly.

audits.title: Has a <meta name="viewport"> tag with width or initial-scale
audits.description: A viewport tag optimizes the app for mobile screens.

audits.title: Links to cross-origin destinations are safe
audits.description: Add rel='noopener' or rel='noreferrer' to any external links with target='_blank'.

seo.title: SEO
seo.description: Validates technical optimization for search engines like Google and Bing.

audits.title: Document has a <title> element
audits.displayValue: "Pavan Homecare | In-Home Senior Care & Ca..." (91 chars)
audits.description: The title gives search engine users a primary overview of the page content.

audits.title: Document has a meta description
audits.description: The meta description may be included in search results to summarize page content.

audits.title: Document has a single, descriptive <h1> heading
audits.description: Search engines use H1 headings to identify the primary topic of the page.

audits.title: Structured data (Schema.org JSON-LD) is valid
audits.description: Structured data enables rich search results like star ratings, FAQs, and local business snippets.

audits.title: Page has OpenGraph social sharing meta tags
audits.description: OpenGraph tags ensure rich link previews when shared on Facebook, LinkedIn, Twitter, and iMessage.
